about_the_game:
This is a Diablo 2like game where you will play the role of an Avengers with superpowers. Your country is completely captured and destroyed by another country, and you are one of the few survivors.
You are being subjected to biological experiments by scientists from hostile countries, but unexpectedly gain superpowers and escape. As you grow, you decide to return all the torment you have suffered to the other party, and you must kill every enemy.
You can learn talents, allocate attribute points, choose initial attributes, hire warriors, learn superpowers, learn features, equip and set gems, choose movement routes, fight against different monsters or destroy enemy cities, and slaughter enemy civilians.

content_descriptors.notes:
There are a small number of rape scenes and a large number of bloody and violent scenes and plots.
In the early stages of the plot manga, the protagonist's sister is gang raped and killed by soldiers from Morgan State.
In the mid game plot manga, the protagonist's girlfriend is raped by a perverted assassin
(But not completely exposed, only partially suggestive)
